notes_zh:
- **新增** 认出文案里的链接和网盘提取码：「分享文案 + 短链」「网盘链接 + 提取码」这类内容整条不是网址，以前只能手动选中再走右键服务，现在 ⌘K 里直接多出「打开 xxx」（P）和「粘贴提取码」（K）（#89，感谢 @zhhlwd 的反馈）
- **新增** 短信验证码独立成一类，快捷面板标签栏和主窗口侧边栏都能直接筛；没开短信转发的不会看到这一项
- **新增** 快捷面板的标签栏分类可以拖着排序、单独关掉，全关时整排不再占位（感谢 @csdog 的贡献）
- **新增** 预览区正文字号可调，11 到 20pt（感谢 @csdog 的贡献）
- **优化** ⌘↩ 现在对所有条目都是纯文本粘贴，链接条目也不例外；打开网页改走 ⌘K 里的「打开链接」（P）或 ⌘O
- **优化** 设置窗口向系统设置看齐：侧边栏固定宽度、不再可拖，标题栏加上前进 / 后退
- **优化** 快捷面板的滚动条去掉灰色槽轨，只留滑块
- **优化** 状态栏菜单的退出项不再带应用名，就叫「退出」
- **修复** 重命名分组后，该组条目还挂在旧名字下：新名字点进去是空的，旧名字又没有入口
- **修复** 用输入法打拼音时，搜索框的占位文字盖在拼音上
notes_en:
- **New** Links and access codes are now recognized inside mixed text. Share blurbs and cloud-drive messages aren't URLs as a whole, so they used to need manual selection plus a right-click service; ⌘K now offers "Open xxx" (P) and "Paste code" (K) directly (#89, thanks @zhhlwd for the report)
- **New** SMS verification codes are their own filter, available in both the Quick Paste tab bar and the main window sidebar — hidden entirely if SMS forwarding is off
- **New** Quick Paste tab categories can be reordered by dragging and switched off individually; the bar disappears when all are off (thanks @csdog for the contribution)
- **New** Preview body font size is configurable, 11 to 20 pt (thanks @csdog for the contribution)
- **Improve** ⌘↩ now means plain-text paste for every item, links included; opening a link moved to "Open Link" (P) in ⌘K, or ⌘O
- **Improve** The Settings window follows System Settings more closely: fixed sidebar width, no longer draggable, with back / forward in the title bar
- **Improve** The Quick Paste scrollbar drops its grey track and keeps just the knob
- **Improve** The status bar menu's quit item no longer carries the app name — it's simply "Quit"
- **Fix** Renaming a group left its clips under the old name: the new name opened empty and the old one had no entry point
- **Fix** The search field's placeholder covered pinyin while composing with an input method
